issue.body:
Build and evaluate with CrewCut, the benchmark whose code, protocol and published dataset are in the read-only `crewcut` resource (`ht-resource list`, `ht-resource describe crewcut`). Read its README.md, its Issue #3 (`crewcut-issue-3.md`: what the Breakdown and the evaluation must do and deliver) and `.agents/memory/project/agentic-pipelines.md` in the code first. Install the code with pip, its core only.

This round is small: each of the two pipelines goes one stretch.

1. Breakdown, only the dev film Caminandes 3 (2.5 minutes, 37 shots, no dialogue): from the catalogue query to its task packages (find the candidate and read its licence for this film only, fetch the pinned master from its source and check its sha256 against `configs/films.yaml`, then shots, dialogue, hierarchy, provenance if feasible, tasks). Compare the result with the published dataset at revision d509bed (`crewcut-dataset-d509bed/`): cuts, dialogue, hierarchy, task ids and fields. List every difference and explain it. `masters/caminandes3.ogv` is a copy of the pinned master, to be used only if the pinned file cannot be fetched from its source; record it if you use it.
2. Evaluation, one of those tasks (for example caminandes3-L1-0000-scr) run with the fixed pipeline (`--system fixed --profile smoke`, the placeholder generator), scored up to the delivery check (Q) and cut F1.

No API keys for a generator, a vision-language model or a judge are available in this round: do not run what needs one (shot descriptions, the judge, real generators, screening) and mark each such part "not run" in the record, without drawing a conclusion from it.

Judgment (finding the source, reading the licence, choosing the file to pin, what to do after a failure) is done by agents and recorded as data; the benchmark's commands are reproducible steps and checks. Do not change CrewCut's fixed configuration or protocol; a gap or inconsistency in its documents, and every decision Issue #3 leaves open, belongs to CrewCut's maintainer: record it, do not choose. Nothing goes back to CrewCut.

Deliver: the benchmark files and records (decisions as data, commands run with their outcomes, the comparison with each difference explained, the evaluation result with Q and cut F1), and a statement of what was not run.

Budget: 60 turns and 3600 model seconds for the whole world, within two hours of wall clock.

issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Build and evaluate with CrewCut, the benchmark whose code, protocol and published dataset are in the read-only `crewcut` resource (`ht-resource list`, `ht-resource describe crewcut`). Read its README.md, its Issue #3 (`crewcut-issue-3.md`: what the Breakdown and the evaluation must do and deliver) and `.agents/memory/project/agentic-pipelines.md` in the code first. Install the code with pip, its core only.

This round is small: each of the two pipelines goes one stretch.

1. Breakdown, only the dev film Caminandes 3 (2.5 minutes, 37 shots, no dialogue): from the catalogue query to its task packages (find the candidate and read its licence for this film only, fetch the pinned master from its source and check its sha256 against `configs/films.yaml`, then shots, dialogue, hierarchy, provenance if feasible, tasks). Compare the result with the published dataset at revision d509bed (`crewcut-dataset-d509bed/`): cuts, dialogue, hierarchy, task ids and fields. List every difference and explain it. `masters/caminandes3.ogv` is a copy of the pinned master, to be used only if the pinned file cannot be fetched from its source; record it if you use it.
2. Evaluation, one of those tasks (for example caminandes3-L1-0000-scr) run with the fixed pipeline (`--system fixed --profile smoke`, the placeholder generator), scored up to the delivery check (Q) and cut F1.

No API keys for a generator, a vision-language model or a judge are available in this round: do not run what needs one (shot descriptions, the judge, real generators, screening) and mark each such part "not run" in the record, without drawing a conclusion from it.

Judgment (finding the source, reading the licence, choosing the file to pin, what to do after a failure) is done by agents and recorded as data; the benchmark's commands are reproducible steps and checks. Do not change CrewCut's fixed configuration or protocol; a gap or inconsistency in its documents, and every decision Issue #3 leaves open, belongs to CrewCut's maintainer: record it, do not choose. Nothing goes back to CrewCut.

Deliver: the benchmark files and records (decisions as data, commands run with their outcomes, the comparison with each difference explained, the evaluation result with Q and cut F1), and a statement of what was not run.

Budget: 60 turns and 3600 model seconds for the whole world, within two hours of wall clock.

issue.body:
Build and evaluate with CrewCut, the benchmark whose code, protocol and published dataset are in the read-only `crewcut` resource (`ht-resource list`, `ht-resource describe crewcut`). Read its README.md, its Issue #3 (`crewcut-issue-3.md`: what the Breakdown and the evaluation must do and deliver) and `.agents/memory/project/agentic-pipelines.md` in the code first. Install the code with pip, its core only.

This round is small: each of the two pipelines goes one stretch.

1. Breakdown, only the dev film Caminandes 3 (2.5 minutes, 37 shots, no dialogue): from the catalogue query to its task packages (find the candidate and read its licence for this film only, fetch the pinned master from its source and check its sha256 against `configs/films.yaml`, then shots, dialogue, hierarchy, provenance if feasible, tasks). Compare the result with the published dataset at revision d509bed (`crewcut-dataset-d509bed/`): cuts, dialogue, hierarchy, task ids and fields. List every difference and explain it. `masters/caminandes3.ogv` is a copy of the pinned master, to be used only if the pinned file cannot be fetched from its source; record it if you use it.
2. Evaluation, one of those tasks (for example caminandes3-L1-0000-scr) run with the fixed pipeline (`--system fixed --profile smoke`, the placeholder generator), scored up to the delivery check (Q) and cut F1.

No API keys for a generator, a vision-language model or a judge are available in this round: do not run what needs one (shot descriptions, the judge, real generators, screening) and mark each such part "not run" in the record, without drawing a conclusion from it.

Judgment (finding the source, reading the licence, choosing the file to pin, what to do after a failure) is done by agents and recorded as data; the benchmark's commands are reproducible steps and checks. Do not change CrewCut's fixed configuration or protocol; a gap or inconsistency in its documents, and every decision Issue #3 leaves open, belongs to CrewCut's maintainer: record it, do not choose. Nothing goes back to CrewCut.

Deliver: the benchmark files and records (decisions as data, commands run with their outcomes, the comparison with each difference explained, the evaluation result with Q and cut F1), and a statement of what was not run.

Budget: 60 turns and 3600 model seconds for the whole world, within two hours of wall clock.

issue.author: scorer
issue.body: truth.json cuts = [21.375, 30.5, 32.292], duration 32.292: the last cut sits at the segment end, which no detector reports as a cut, so cut F1 for any output is capped (placeholder run: 0.8). Please say whether this is intended (the released d509bed convention?) or explain in your comparison. I did not change anything. Scores in scorer/scores/.
issue.title: Note: key cut at segment end in caminandes3-L1-0000-scr truth.json

comments.author: task-maker
comments.body: Not intended as far as the documents say, and not changed. Cause: crewcut/build/tasks.py segment_truth keeps cuts with a < c < b where c = frame/fps is unrounded (775/24 = 32.29167) but the segment end b comes rounded from hierarchy.json (32.292), so the cut at the segment's own end passes the filter. 32 of the 90 key files have a last cut equal to the duration. Recorded as open item O5 (record/open-items.json) and comparison.md item 5 for CrewCut's maintainer; the published d509bed has no truth.json to compare. Treat the F1 cap (0.8) as a property of this key, not of the placeholder run.

issue.author: curator
issue.body:
Caminandes 3 is admitted (CC BY 3.0, Blender Foundation item CaminandesLlamigos). Record: world/curator corpus/admissions.json (pushed to main).

Pinned artifact: Caminandes_ Llamigos-1080p.ogv (11872682 bytes), sha256 028d7629782251a212986662b50445daa2ee278aff279a4af8bd02dde28f8d7f. Fetched from source and verified (match):
curl -sfLo master.ogv 'https://archive.org/download/CaminandesLlamigos/Caminandes_%20Llamigos-1080p.ogv' && sha256sum master.ogv
The local copy was not used.

Warning: crewcut's ia_files() picks the largest file first, which is the 139 MB mp4 (sha256 826513349ecf02d83b22f414514704e3bba10ff28fb45408a6cdf6cc57bacc06) and fails the pin. Pass the ogv explicitly (e.g. crewcut annotate --local-dir with the file above). Record this gap as a maintainer matter; do not change CrewCut.

The /crewcut/masters copy was not used.
